banks.bank: Bank of St Vincent and the Grenadines

note: The Bank of St Vincent and the Grenadines' fees and charges (revised December 2024, in force from 10 March 2025), published on its fees page as an embedded document: a savings account's monthly charge to maintain it is 3 dollars. Its chequing accounts have no monthly maintenance fee but charge 2 dollars a cheque in ledger fees, which the game doesn't count.
